comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Awarded to those who register for Leclerc's camp during Epic Pirate Feud and perform well in sinking NPCs and/or opposing camp players. The higher your score, the more of these items you will receive.

Apparently, this ticket can drop the following at random:

French Admiral Outfit
Canned Marbled Beef Steak
Pirate Justaucorps
Jolly Roger

Other possible contents currently unknown.
